facts: Hazards bypass Protect, have foeSide request target and no accuracy/damage draw. Placement has no hit-loop Update; ordinary scheduler Updates remain exact.
Spikes layers 1/2/3 deal floor(maxHP/8), floor(maxHP/6), floor(maxHP/4), minimum 1. Levitate skips Spikes without disclosure; all three supported species take neutral Stealth Rock.
Switch-in hazards execute in placement order in runSwitch, before pending attacks. Entry KOs resolve then queue/residual resumes; replacement chains keep the turn pending.
Rapid Spin has Gen 5 power20, maxPP64, Normal STAB and Ghost immunity; Protect prevents clearing. Clear own Spikes then Stealth Rock after damage, before hit-loop Update/faint/win. No Speed boost.
A foeSide hazard still succeeds after recoil leaves no opposing active target; its move target is the side label without [notarget]. Minimum Spikes damage verified on a level-1 entrant.
